full_judgment:
3. The case land appertaining to CS Khatian Nos.1028 and 979 within Mouza Kapasia, Police Station Paba, District Rajshahi belonged to one Soleman. Accordingly his name was recorded in the SA Khatian. Thereafter said Soleman transferred his land to Mofezuddin Fakir, predecessor of the petitioner and opposite party Nos.3 and 4 in the year 1972 vide Kabala Nos.33382 and 41296. This Mofezuddin died leaving behind the present petitioner and opposite party Nos.3 and 4. Opposite party No.3 transferred the case land to opposite parties 1 and 2 on 4-9-2008 vide Kabala No. 12014 of 2008 for a consideration of Taka 6,36,000. Opposite party Nos.1 and 2 are quite strangers. The petitioner came to learn about the sale on 7-9-2008. The petitioner after obtaining the certified copy of the same on 11-9-2008 filed the instant case. 

 4. Opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 appeared before the Court below by filing an application under Order VII, rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure (Herein after referred as said Code) for rejection of the Miscellaneous Case. They also filed a written-objection, stating that, the owners of the case land had been owning and possessing their respective shares by virtue of registered deed of partition being No.8045 dated 10-8-1996. They got their names mutated and separated the Khatian. The Joint District Judge, after hearing both the parties allowed the application filed under Order VII, rule 11 of the said Code rejecting the instant Miscellaneous Case by his order dated 24-11-2010.
